pr_title: Ensure that PeriodCountConsolidatorBase classes only consolidate a single symbol
pr_body:
<!--- Provide a general summary of your changes in the Title above -->

#### Description
Ensures that consolidators derived from the PeriodCountConsolidatorBase class should only consolidate for a single symbol.

#### Related Issue
<!--- This project only accepts pull requests related to open issues -->

<!--- Please link to the issue here: -->

#### Motivation and Context
<!--- Why is this change required? What problem does it solve? -->
Without this change it is possible to incorrectly use a consolidator with multiple symbols, which can end up with incorrect data in the consolidator.

issue_context.title: Consolidators should only consolidate for a single symbol
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
Consolidators should not allow consolidation for multiple symbols.  Seeing more than one symbol in a consolidator is most likely a bug in an algorithm.

#### Actual Behavior
Consolidators allow tick/quote/tradebar data with multiple symbols.

#### Potential Solution
The symbol in the data being consolidated could be checked against the first symbol seen by the consolidator.

I have a change that I will send shortly.

#### Reproducing the Problem
I have a change that I will send shortly.


#### System Information
macOS (but not really relevant)
